text_block_list.text: During a break in summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Spe-chan and company.
Are you doing your best?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan!
We're on a break right now~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: How about heading out sea fishing with me right now?

Invited by Seiun Sky, we left the crowded beach
and went sea fishing. However—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm... not catching a siiiingle thing...!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. The swimming spot is close by, so maybe the fish are on high alert~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, Sei-chan, your rod's been getting
bites non-stop for a while now, hasn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Can I watch you fish for a bit!?
I bet you've got some great tricks to teach, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Waaow, you two are leaning right in and totally in sync.
Just what you'd expect from a Trainer and their Umamusume, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I don't know if it'll be of any help,
but it's no trouble at all~

And so, together with Special Week,
we decided to watch over Seiun Sky while she fished.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Sei-chan, you've been walking along staring at the water
this whole time. Aren't you going to start fishing?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No need to rush, no need to rush.
First, picking the right spot is what's important~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Even if she's on high alert in noisy, crowded,
and dangerous places..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
For instance... in grassy spots like over there
that seem great for hiding, you'll find lots of
girls letting their guard down.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Letting my guard down...! I see...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, found a good spot.
Well then, shall we get started?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Incredible... The way you handle that fishing rod is so versatile and unpredictable, Sei-chan...!

Seiun Sky was certainly making the lure dart quickly at times
and glide gently at others, skillfully drawing the fish in...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What's important is making them think you have the upper hand.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "‘My opponent is weaker than me!’ Let them think that, and just when they move in for the kill—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And right when they're at their most vulnerable,
we flip everything upside down! ...Take that!!
(SPLAAASH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmmm, grrr...!
...Ah, it got away again~!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Spe-chan's still giving it her all.
She's got that same crazy guts as always~
choice_data_list: That was some impressive skill earlier.
That was some impressive skill earlier.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, being praised so much makes me blush☆
...Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: As you can see, I just wasn't blessed with a great physique.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm just vaguely wondering if there's any
way to live merrily through all that, you know~?

There was something unfathomable lurking
in Seiun Sky's expression as he said that...

Her track record clearly shows
that her sharp intellect is put to great use
in her races as well.

Pulling out all the stops to snatch victory,
the "Trickster," Seiun Sky—
choice_data_list: (She's going to be a formidable opponent...!)
(She's going to be quite a formidable rival...!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......Well, but still.
Spe-chan is—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nnnnghhhh... take thiiis!!
(SPLAAAASH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aah! I-I caught it, I caught one...! Trainer, I did ittt~!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, it's huge?!Wah, wha-wha, I-I can't hold all of this...!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Going all out with pure guts in a head-on clash
and pulling off something like that... sheesh."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You really are strong.
...That's why—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan, thanks for inviting me today!
Fishing was so much fun...!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nyahahaha, that's great then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, thanks for keeping me company.
Good night~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Sei-chan, you were amazing.
I'm sure during the race, tactics like that will—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...!!
choice_data_list: We need to work on building up your physical strength.
We need to work on building up your physical strength.
We'll have to forge an unshakeable heart.
We'll have to forge an unshakeable heart.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...!!
choice_data_list: We need to work on building up your physical strength.
We need to work on building up your physical strength.
We'll have to forge an unshakeable heart.
We'll have to forge an unshakeable heart.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Even if I get turned around,
I'll just turn it around right back!
As long as I have that kind of power...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All riiight, now that that's settled, tire pulling!
Powered up to the absolute max...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I'll pull you along
too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —At around 60 km/h!

And so, together with Special Week,
we prepared for the decisive battle against Seiun Sky through all-out training that literally put our bodies on the line.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I must stay on guard
and not let myself get swept up in their pace...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, heart, huh...
How should we go about training that?
choice_data_list: Like, holding back from eating delicious things?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hau?!
Th-That... sounds like it'd really work~...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What brutal training...!
B-But... to beat Sei-chan...!
Nnnngh...!!

And so, dedicating ourselves to special training
to strengthen our resolve, we prepared for the
decisive battle against Seiun Sky...
